meanings.note: partitive genitive чаю is common: чашка чаю

examples.text: А я вот вам чаю с сушками принёс.
examples.trans: I've brought you some tea and bread rings.
Now I'll make some tea too.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: the thing that ends is the subject
деньги закончились = the money ran out

examples.text: Всё, выборы закончились. Тебя начальник ждёт.
examples.trans: That's it, the election is over. Your boss is waiting for you.
Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: налей мне чаю = pour me some tea; налей мужу = pour your husband a drink

examples.trans: Nina, pour your husband a drink. We've got something to celebrate!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: Formed with a diminutive/expressive Slavic suffix adding warmth or small scale. Common feminine noun meaning 'small cup' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Oh, pour me a cup, would you?

examples.text: Это слово «чашечка» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'small cup' is often heard in conversation.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'нести'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to bring (carrying)', paired with 'приносить'.

examples.trans: What did you bring into the flat?

examples.text: А я вот вам чаю с сушками принёс.
examples.trans: I've brought you some tea and bread rings.

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: Formed with a diminutive/expressive Slavic suffix adding warmth or small scale. Common masculine noun meaning 'tea (diminutive)' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Chef, do you want to drink some tea?

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'ражаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'be amazed'.

examples.trans: I have to hand it to you, Viktor Petrovich.

examples.text: Это слово «поражаться» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'be amazed' is often heard in conversation.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'хваченный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('under control, covered').

examples.trans: You have got everything under control.

examples.text: Это слово «схваченный» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'under control' is often heard in conversation.

meanings.note: сколько стоит? = how much is it?

examples.trans: And how much does the console cost?

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry

meanings.en: to think it over, to give it a thought

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.en: to cool down, get cold (of food, drink, or anger)

examples.text: Пей чай, пока он не остыл.
examples.trans: Drink your tea before it gets cold.

examples.text: А ты иди в комнату. Завтрак ещё не остыл.
examples.trans: And you go to the room. Breakfast hasn't gone cold yet.

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

examples.text: Нет, Вика, я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: No, Vika, that's not what I mean at all.

examples.text: Свежие ягоды, кофе! У вас тут романтический завтрак.
examples.trans: Fresh berries, coffee! You are having a romantic breakfast here.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'варить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'brew, steep'.

examples.text: Ой, остыл совсем, я свежий заварю.
examples.trans: Oh, it has gone cold. I will brew a fresh pot.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

examples.text: Ничего страшного. Теперь мы одна команда.
examples.trans: Nothing serious. Now we're one team.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to love, to like', paired with 'полюбить'.

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.en: hot (to the touch, of food/drink, not weather)
meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('hot').

examples.trans: Careful, the cup is very hot.

examples.text: Аркаша, держи горячий чай. И бутерброд с вареньем ешь.
examples.trans: Arkasha, here's some hot tea. And eat a jam sandwich.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.
